---
title: HTML runtime
format:
  html:
    toc: true
filters:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    groups:
      - name: advanced
        level: 1
        shown: true
        label: Advanced
      - name: expert
        level: 2
        shown: false
        label: Expert
      - name: backup
        shown: false
        label: Backup
      - name: veil
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The runtime markup and the HTML runtime.
        check: "node veil-check.mjs"
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<section id="sec-expert"[^>]*data-veil-group="expert"[^>]*data-veil-hidden', '<div id="div-both"[^>]*data-veil-group="advanced backup"[^>]*data-veil-hidden', '<div id="callout-note"[^>]*data-veil-group="expert"', '<div id="callout-note"[^>]*data-veil-hidden', '<div id="fig-veiled"[^>]*data-veil-group="expert"', '<div id="fig-veiled"[^>]*data-veil-hidden', '<div id="tbl-veiled"[^>]*data-veil-group="expert"', '<div id="tbl-veiled"[^>]*data-veil-hidden', '<div id="cell-veiled"[^>]*data-veil-group="expert"', '<div id="cell-veiled"[^>]*data-veil-hidden', '<script type="application/json" id="veil-config">', 'veil\.js']
        - ['<section id="sec-advanced"[^>]*data-veil-hidden', ' group="']
---
